address: Route du Gévaudan, La Garde, Albaret-Sainte-Marie, 48200, France
bio: A country inn done out in an original style! The chef-owner is into interior design and likes to shake things up, both on the decor front – you'll notice the eclectic style – and when it comes to the food. On the menu, local flavours get a modern twist (crayfish ravioli on a pepper velouté, pork mignon in a Cantal crust, carrot purée with vanilla etc)....
